title: What Machine Learning Actually Is
description: Build an honest mental model of ML before touching a library: what a model is, and what training means.
learningOutcomes: Explain supervised vs. unsupervised learning with real examples
Explain train/test splits and why they matter

lessons.title: What Is a Model?
lessons.description: A model as a function fit to data, not a magic black box.
learningObjectives: Define a model as parameters plus a prediction function

lessons.title: Supervised vs. Unsupervised Learning
lessons.description: The two broad problem shapes, with real examples of each.
learningObjectives: Classify a problem as supervised or unsupervised
Give real examples of each category

lessons.title: Train/Test Split and Generalization
lessons.description: Why a model that memorizes training data is worthless.
learningObjectives: Explain why you never evaluate on training data

lessons.title: Overfitting and Underfitting
lessons.description: Recognize both failure modes before you can fix either.
learningObjectives: Recognize overfitting from a learning curve
Recognize underfitting from poor training performance
Name at least three fixes for each
